app.title: Case opener - Battle simulator
app.descr:
Crate Duel Simulator is a fast-paced crate opening simulator where you challenge an AI opponent in simulated PvP duels. Open multiple cases at once, compare item values, and whoever gets the better drop wins the full inventory.

Each battle feels like a real showdown — win more, earn more, and build the ultimate collection.

Features:

Clicker to earn currency


Case opening statistics with luck check - are you luckier then a regular player? Check out in our game!

Simulated PvP battles against smart AI

Open up to 10 cases in one round

Battle logic based on item rarity and simulated value

Winner takes all loot - no mercy

Choose from a wide range of classic and premium crates

Track your win rate, battle history, and item collection

New crates and cosmetic drops added frequently

Note: This is a simulation game. Items gained in this app are for entertainment only and cannot be used in any official game.

Download Crate Opening Battle now and prove your luck in high-stakes case duels.
